I am a postdoctoral fellow in the Department of Biostatistics at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, working with [Muxuan Liang](https://www.muxuan.me/) and [Ruitao Lin](https://faculty.mdanderson.org/profiles/ruitao_lin.html). I received my Ph.D. in Statistics from the University of Florida in 2026, under the supervision of [Joseph Antonelli](https://jantonelli111.github.io/).

My research interests include causal inference, semiparametric methods, Bayesian methods, survival analysis, clinical trials, and real-world evidence.

For my research and publications, please visit my [Google Scholar profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=JN4GeTgAAAAJ).
